candidates.en: a retro color grade explicitly treated as later simulation
Keep the adult subject, the functional place, and the ongoing task legible in one environmental frame.
Show the actor, the object of the action, and a small visible consequence in the same frame.
Set camera distance so the requested body coverage and surrounding space share one coherent perspective.
Keep the task-bearing subject details readable while foreground and background soften according to distance.
Expose the indoor subject for readable detail while retaining a spatially credible brighter window and a limited highlight loss.
At portrait scale, preserve gentle skin tone changes and lighting-shaped detail without imposing blemishes.
Keep a few flyaway hairs attached to the hairline, with their direction explained by the scene's motion or air.
Let garment folds start at visible seams, joints, or a pulling hand and follow the fabric's actual movement.
Confine the chosen wear or handling trace to the material and contact point that could produce it.
Seat the object on a visible support with a small contact shadow and scene-consistent falloff.
Bind the selected reflection to a visible surface, matching source object, and camera viewpoint.
Let a frame edge crop a peripheral moving part while keeping the adult and the main action legible.
If the selected digital capture is dim, keep fine noise mainly in the shadows while the lit subject stays readable.
For an explicitly reposted compressed image, keep mild compression near high-contrast edges without obscuring the action.
Keep restrained grain inside the picture area and any scan dust on the separate print surface.
Show a complete instant print as a physical card with an image window, border, thickness, and supported contact.
Use a stationary high viewpoint that covers the monitored passage, with the passing adult occupying a small part.
Present one camcorder video frame at a legible action phase with only local motion smear and coherent frame treatment.
Keep near forms detailed and let distant forms lose some contrast only along the actual long viewing path.
